title: Install core runtime dependencies
description: Install all runtime and dev dependencies required for the Rocket CLI. This includes the CLI framework, TUI library, UI components, file utilities, validation library, and terminal utilities.
acceptanceCriteria: commander is installed as a runtime dependency
ink is installed as a runtime dependency
react is installed as a runtime dependency
ink-select-input is installed as a runtime dependency
ink-spinner is installed as a runtime dependency
ink-text-input is installed as a runtime dependency
fs-extra is installed as a runtime dependency
zod is installed as a runtime dependency
strip-ansi is installed as a runtime dependency
@types/* packages are installed for all packages that need them

steps.details: Run: `npm install commander ink react ink-select-input ink-spinner ink-text-input fs-extra zod strip-ansi`. These are all needed at runtime.
Run: `npm install --save-dev @types/react @types/fs-extra`. Note: commander, zod, and strip-ansi include their own types. ink and its plugins include their own types as well.
Run `node -e "import('commander').then(() => console.log('commander ok'))"` to spot-check. Alternatively, verify that node_modules/ contains directories for all installed packages.
Review npm install output for peer dependency warnings. Ink requires a specific React version — ensure they are compatible. Fix any critical peer dependency issues.

technicalNotes: Ink v5 requires React 18+. Check ink's peerDependencies before installing
strip-ansi v7+ is ESM-only — ensure package.json has type: 'module' (already set in TASK-1)
fs-extra is a drop-in replacement for Node's fs module with additional utilities like ensureDir, copy, etc.
